title: Operations Manager
description:
Experience: 5+ Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Department: Operations
 Role: Operations Manager 
 About the Role We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Manager to oversee daily business operations, improve operational efficiency, manage resources, and ensure smooth coordination across departments. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to streamline processes, manage teams, and drive business performance. 
 Key Responsibilities Oversee day-to-day business operations and ensure efficient execution of activities across departments. Develop, implement, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, and operational processes. Define, monitor, and evaluate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure operational targets and business objectives are achieved. Manage resource planning, workforce allocation, scheduling, and capacity utilisation. Prepare and manage operational budgets, monitor expenses, control costs, and identify opportunities for cost optimisation. Lead, supervise, mentor, and develop the operations team, ensuring accountability and productivity. Coordinate with internal departments, vendors, clients, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth business operations. Monitor project timelines, service delivery, and quality standards to ensure timely execution. Identify operational risks, resolve bottlenecks, and implement corrective and preventive measures. Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, and quality standards. Prepare and present MIS reports, operational dashboards, and performance updates to senior management. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, efficiency, and overall business performance. 
 Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. MBA or Postgraduate Diploma in Operations or Project Management is preferred. Certifications such as PMP, Six Sigma (Green Belt/Black Belt), Lean Management, or ITIL will be an added advantage. 
 Experience & Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in operations management or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial position. Proven experience managing cross-functional teams of 10 or more employees. Experience handling multiple projects, operational functions, or business locations. Hands-on experience in budgeting, cost control, resource planning, and operational performance management. Demonstrated experience in developing SOPs, streamlining workflows, and implementing performance measurement systems. Experience in vendor management, contract negotiations, and SLA monitoring. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Operational & Analytical Skills Strong understanding of process improvement and operational excellence. Excellent resource planning, scheduling, and capacity management skills. Ability to identify operational risks and implement effective solutions. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making abilities. Experience with MIS reporting, dashboards, and performance tracking. Technical Skills Proficiency in MS Office and Google Workspace, particularly advanced Excel/Google Sheets. Working knowledge of ERP, CRM, and project management tools such as SAP, Zoho, Jira, or Asana. Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools is an advantage. Leadership & Communication Skills Strong team management, delegation, and decision-making abilities. Experience in hiring, training, performance management, and conflict resolution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to coordinate with senior management, clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. High level of accountability, integrity, ownership, and organizational skills. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a proactive leader who can independently manage business operations, establish structured processes, improve team productivity, and ensure operational goals are achieved through effective planning, execution, and monitoring.

Key Skills: Administration management,Office coordination,Facility management,Coordination,Facility administration,Administration,Operations management,Office
